title: Scripture and Hope
definition: Scripture and hope belong together because God's Word anchors believers in His promises, salvation, character, and future restoration.
summary: Biblical hope rests on what God has promised and accomplished in Christ.
christFocus: Jesus is the believer's living hope, secured by His resurrection and return.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Biblical hope is not wishful thinking. It is confident expectation grounded in God's character, promises, and saving work in Christ.

Scripture strengthens hope by reminding believers what God has done, what He has promised, and where history is going. The Word lifts the eyes beyond present pain.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Hopelessness grows when people listen only to circumstances, fear, or shame. Scripture and hope matters because God's promises speak louder than despair.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Return to the promises of God when hope feels weak. Write them down, pray them back to God, and encourage others with the hope Scripture gives.
